title: Keyboard shortcuts
scrollList: Scroll the list (the selection stays put)
reorder: Move the cell among its siblings
cycleStatus: Cycle status / toggle achieved / cycle a commitment's verdict (double-tap enters a subtree)
toggleSubtreeCollapsed: Collapse or expand the cell and everything under it
centerOnNode: Center the view on the selection
enterBySearch: Search for a node and enter its subtree
openTab: Open a new tab at the current subtree
closeTab: Close the tab (the last one closes the window)
jumpToTab: Jump to a tab by position (Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+9)
toggleFullscreen: Show the board alone (hide the tabs and top bar)
statusUnblock: Status preset: Unblock (blocked tasks only, List View)
toggleBacklog: Put in / take out of the backlog
cycleVerdict: Cycle the selected commitment's verdict (Unresolved → Kept → Broken)
markBroken: Mark the selected commitment broken (again to clear it)
createChildRow: Create a child of the selected row
createSiblingRow: Create a sibling of the selected row
planMoveAcross: Plan the selected task into the scope, or take it back out
planSwitchPane: Move between the candidates and the scope
stepsNavigate: Move between the cards on this Step
stepsPage: Turn to the previous / next page of this Step
